contract: v3.5 (ReactFlow分阶段执行提示词_ReactFlowDelta科研合同_v3_5_M0R2_20260731.md)
purpose: M0-R FAIL remediation:彻底去除 delta 参数化的 positive bump，使 delta = correction_net(delta_thermo_context) 可正可负，打破非负性链。M0-R 证明'保留 bump + delta_thermo 进 encoder'不足以消除 pred_min=0.0 的非负性偏差。

trigger.m0r_root_cause: delta = bump*0.1 + correction(z_w); on OOD parent correction collapses near-zero, delta dominated by positive bump (bump>=0); through b=w_sym*delta (w_sym=softplus>=0) yields delta_r_hat>=0; cannot predict negative delta (true min=-0.111)
trigger.m0r_fundamental_limitation: the parameterization itself must change (e.g. signed bump, or correction without positive bias, or removing the bump term); No amount of input feature augmentation can overcome this

scope.feature_change: NONE - feature dim stays 10 (5 WT thermo + 5 delta_thermo, reused from M0-R mutant_thermo_features.npz, NOT recomputed)

parameterization_fix.description: delta = correction_net(concat(z_w[lo:hi].flatten(), delta_thermo[lo:hi].flatten())); NO bump term; delta can be positive or negative
bump_removal_locations: ForcingModule.forward L234 (bump = torch.exp(...)) and L237 (delta_window = bump.unsqueeze(-1) * 0.1): DELETED
EPROModel.forward L656-658 (duplicate bump + delta[lo:hi] = bump*0.1): DELETED

correction_net_input.rationale: delta_thermo directly drives correction_net, bypassing encoder OOD collapse. z_w retained for learned context.

parameterization_fix.delta_computation: delta_window = correction_net(context).unsqueeze(-1); NO bump addition; delta fully learned, can be negative
parameterization_fix.w_sym_unchanged: w_sym = F.softplus(0.5*z_sum.sum + 0.25*z_abs_diff.sum) >= 0 (NOT modified; delta negative => b=w_sym*delta negative, breaking non-negativity chain at delta ring)
parameterization_fix.forcing_return_change: ForcingModule.forward returns (b, delta) instead of b only; EPROModel.forward uses returned delta (removes duplicate L651-665 computation)
parameterization_fix.batch_change: EPROModel.forward batch adds 'delta_thermo' key (n, 5); train.py separates delta_thermo from features for forcing input
parameterization_fix.initialization: correction_net Linear weights normal_(std=0.01), bias zeros_ (same as M0-R)
architecture_unchanged: ThermoEncoder (MLP, learned, hidden=512, layers=3, input dim 10)

not_authorized: EPRO-Core (6-15M params, bounded endpoint correction, node+edge forcing, stable sparse susceptibility new form, odd nonlinear switch, P1/P2, heteroscedastic output)
alt inference (only 3-alt marginalization, reused from M0-R)
recomputing delta_thermo features (must reuse M0-R npz)

training_config.split: by-parent (same as M0/M0-R: train=4 parents, val=Tetrahymena P4-P6)

gate.gate_name: M0-R2 Gate (v3.5 §5.1, identical to M0-R Gate v3.4 §5.1)

bullets.name: validation_skill_positive
bullets.definition: mean per-pair Skill on validation (parent holdout=Tetrahymena P4-P6) > 0

bullets.name: beats_strongest_independent
bullets.definition: EPRO-Lite (M0-R2) val Skill >= strongest independent baseline (static_reactivity)

bullets.name: beats_matched_generic_paired
bullets.definition: EPRO-Lite (M0-R2) val Skill > matched generic paired baseline (v3 §10.4)

bullets.name: single_seed
bullets.definition: exactly one seed (42), no seed追加

bullets.name: param_count_within_epro_lite
bullets.definition: trainable param count <= 5,000,000 (EPRO-Lite range, not escalated to EPRO-Core)

bullets.name: pred_min_negative
bullets.definition: min prediction on validation < 0 (verifies non-negativity bias eliminated, can predict negative delta) - CORE VERIFICATION BULLET for M0-R2
bullets.note: M0-R FAIL on this bullet (pred_min=0.0, n_negative=0/6464); M0-R2 target: pred_min<0, n_negative>0

fail_forward.on_fail: freeze evidence, diagnose per v3 §18, do NOT enlarge model, do NOT auto-enter M0-R3 or M1 (v3.5 §2.3 item 12), record failure_record.json, forward-only. If pred_min still 0.0 after bump removal, record honestly as architectural limit of EPRO-Lite observation/susceptibility chain, do NOT modify w_sym/observation (v3.5 §2.3 item 13).
fail_forward.on_pass: record training_run.json + mechanism_failure_matrix.json (M0 vs M0-R vs M0-R2 3-way) + model_card_draft.md; M0-R2 PASS does NOT auto-enter M1 (M1 needs Tier A + new contract per v3.4 §8)

frozen_against_modification: This preregistration is committed BEFORE M0-R2 execution starts. Thresholds, definitions, parameterization method, and correction_net input concatenation above MUST NOT be modified after commit (v3.5 §5.1, §4.2). Any modification requires new contract amendment.
